description: Committed autonomous backlog. The .github/workflows/autonomous.yml cron seeds these tasks into the inbox each cycle and the executor runs them. Tasks are recurring and idempotent by design (the runner workspace is ephemeral, so every cycle produces a fresh result). Add tasks here to give the autonomous workforce real work; keep instructions read-only unless you intend repo edits.

tasks.name: Malawi service catalog executive summary
tasks.instruction: Read docs/service-catalog-malawi.md. In 3-4 sentences, summarize the offer tiers and name the single offer you would pitch first to a new SME client in Malawi. Use only read tools (read/grep/list); do not modify any files.

tasks.name: Operating status digest
tasks.instruction: Read docs/STATUS.md and run `git log -5 --oneline`. In 4-5 sentences, summarize the current project state, the last shipped milestone, and any open risks. Use only read tools (read/grep/list) and read-only git commands; do not modify any files.

tasks.name: CI posture digest
tasks.instruction: Read docs/DEVELOPMENT.md and .github/workflows/ci.yml. In 4-5 sentences, summarize the CI jobs and their purpose, and flag any workflow definition under .github/workflows that appears inert (for example one that has no successful historical run or is always skipped). Use only read tools (read/grep/list); do not modify any files.
